comparison.objective: Commission a locked-out damper, versus post a wet-floor sign before wiping a spill.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine hex/collar manipulation and test-response iteration; record requires sign transport and stable placement followed by pressed wiping passes.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires safe repeated physical cycles under mechanical limits. Record requires the sign posted 6–20 cm from the spill before sponge contact and staged puddle coverage, with order violation permanently zeroing score.
comparison.reason: Both enforce safety-critical ordering, but the custodial task tests rule compliance and wiping rather than mechanism adjustment or dynamic commissioning.
